subject: Journal entry for credit claim VEN020-0027
body:
Dear Accounts lead,

Record VEN020-0027 appears in GSTR-2B for October 2025, not September 2025. The supplier reported the invoice one return period late, so the credit of Rs 5,635 can be claimed only in the month it appears.

Please make the entry to claim the credit in the month it appears in GSTR-2B.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
